items.title: The Imitation Game
items.explain: 🔢 the codes Alan Turing is trying to crack, 💻 the machine he builds to do it, 🇩🇪 the German Enigma code at the centre of it, 🔐 the encryption he's racing to break.

items.title: The Greatest Showman
items.explain: 🎪 the circus he builds, 🎩 P.T. Barnum, the ringmaster at its centre, 🦁 the extraordinary performers he recruits, 🎶 the big musical numbers throughout.

items.title: Zodiac
items.explain: ✉️ the taunting letters sent to the press, 🔤 the ciphers hidden inside them, 🗞️ the newspaper cartoonist who becomes obsessed with cracking them, ❓ the case that, to this day, was never solved, 🌃 the string of night-time attacks at its centre, 🕰️ the decades the investigation drags on for.

items.title: Dexter
items.explain: 🩸 the blood-spatter analyst by day, 🔪 the meticulous serial killer by night, 🌴 the sun-soaked Miami setting, 😈 the 'Dark Passenger' driving him to kill, 🚔 the police department he works inside undetected.

items.title: Arrival
items.explain: 🛸 the alien spacecraft that appear around the world, 👽 the aliens inside communicating in an unfamiliar language, 🔤 the linguist tasked with decoding it, ⭕ the circular symbols their language is written in, ⏳ the non-linear sense of time it turns out to reveal.

items.title: Shutter Island
items.explain: 🏝️ the remote island setting, 🏥 the psychiatric hospital he's investigating, 🕵️ the U.S. Marshal at the centre of the case, 🧠 the mental illness at the heart of its final twist, ⛈️ the storm that closes in, 🔒 the locked ward hiding the truth, 🌊 the stormy sea cutting the island off from the mainland.

items.title: The Birds
items.explain: 🐔🐥🕊️🦅🦆🦢 the birds themselves — the swarms of different species that turn violently on the town.

items.title: The Irishman
items.explain: 🇮🇪 'Irishman' — his Irish-American heritage, 👨🏻 Frank Sheeran, the man at the centre of the story, 🔫 the decades he spent as a mob hitman.

items.title: Moneyball
items.explain: ⚾ the baseball team at its centre, 📊 the statistics-driven strategy used to build it, 💰 the tight budget they're working with.

items.title: Knives Out
items.explain: 🔪 the knife-shaped clue at the heart of the mystery, 🕵🏻 the detective investigating the death, 🏚️ the old family mansion where it happened, 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 the dysfunctional family full of suspects.

items.title: Money Heist
items.explain: 🔴 the red jumpsuits the crew all wear, 🎭 the Dali masks hiding their identities, 🏛️ the Royal Mint they take over, 💰 the money they print rather than steal, 👨‍🏫 'The Professor', the mastermind directing it all from outside, 🚁 the dramatic escape plan at the heart of it.

items.title: Mindhunter
items.explain: 🕵️ the FBI agents pioneering a new kind of investigation, 🎙️ the taped prison interviews at its centre, 🧠 the psychological profiling method being invented as they go.

items.title: Twin Peaks
items.explain: ⛰️⛰️ 'Twin Peaks' — two mountains, the title spelled out literally, ☕🍩 Agent Cooper's beloved coffee and donuts, 🦉 the owls that recur as an unsettling omen, 🔴 the red curtains of its surreal dream world, 🪵 the Log Lady and the cryptic log she carries everywhere.

items.title: True Detective
items.explain: 🕵️🕵️ the two detectives, decades apart, chasing the same case, 🌀 the spiral symbol tied to the killer, ⭕ 'time is a flat circle' — the show's own words.

items.title: Z Cars
items.explain: 💤 'Z' — the 'zzz' sound standing in for the letter, 🚗🚘 the patrol cars at its centre, 🚓 the police drama the whole show is built around.

items.title: Love Island
items.explain: 🥰😍 the couples falling for each other on camera, 🏝️ the villa on the island where they all live, 👱🏻‍♀️👱🏻‍♂️ the blonde islanders coupling up.

items.title: Broadchurch
items.explain: 🏖️ the small coastal town where it's set, 🔪 the murder that shakes the community, 👮🏻 the two detectives investigating, 👦🏻 the boy whose death starts it all, ⛪ 'Church' — the second half of the town's name.

items.title: Killing Eve
items.explain: 🔪 the assassin at the centre of it, 👩🏻‍🦰 Villanelle, the red-headed killer, 🕵🏻‍♀️ Eve, the MI5 agent hunting her, ❤️ the strange obsession that grows between them.

items.title: Ozark
items.explain: 💵 the cartel money he's forced to launder, 🌊 the Ozarks lake his family relocates to, 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 the family dragged into the danger with him, 🕴️ the cartel figures closing in throughout, 🎰 the casino he builds as a front, 🇲🇽 the cartel he's laundering the money for.

items.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
items.explain: 👧🏻 'Girl' — the hacker at the story's centre, 🐉 the dragon tattoo that gives the title its name, 💻 her brilliant hacking skills, 🔍 the decades-old disappearance she's drawn into investigating, 🖤 her dark, punk aesthetic.

items.title: Gone Girl
items.explain: 💨 the wife who vanishes without a trace, 👰 the picture-perfect marriage everyone believes in, 📔 the diary that seems to reveal the truth, 📺 the media frenzy that follows.

items.title: The Girl on the Train
items.explain: 🚆 the train she rides every day, 👩 the woman at the centre of it, 👀 the couple she watches from the window, 🍷 the drinking that leaves her memory full of blackouts, ❓ the unreliable narrator at the heart of the mystery.

items.title: The Masked Singer
items.explain: 🎭 the masked costume hiding who's underneath, 🎤 the mic each celebrity performs with, 🎶 the songs they sing, 🗣️ the panel trying to guess who's really speaking.

items.title: Suits
items.explain: 👔 the sharp suits the lawyers wear, ⚖️ the top Manhattan law firm they work at, 🗽 the New York setting, 🎓 the fake Harvard degree at the centre of the plot.

items.title: And Then There Were None
items.explain: 🏝️ the remote island they're all lured to, 🔟➡️0️⃣ 'And Then There Were None' — ten strangers trapped there, then none left alive, 🔪 the murders that pick them off one by one.

items.title: The Handmaid's Tale
items.explain: 🔴 the red robes the handmaids are forced to wear, 👒 their white bonnets, 🤰 the forced pregnancies at the regime's core, 👁️ 'Under His Eye' — the surveillance greeting spoken throughout, 🚫📚 women being banned from reading, one of the regime's cruellest rules.
